description: This file defines the SpanBufferWriter struct, which implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface to support Span<byte> in serialization contexts within the Orleans framework. It manages writing to a buffer with capacity checks and provides methods for advancing write position and retrieving memory or span segments.

classes.name: SpanBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a Span<byte>, including capacity management and exception handling.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current write position by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment; throws exception if operation not supported or insufficient capacity.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> segment; throws exception if operation not supported or insufficient capacity.

methods.name: GetException
methods.description: Helper method to generate appropriate exceptions based on capacity checks.
